EXIT_NOW: first available regular raw open start>=closed decision, excluding540/750; otherwise terminal closing-auction close
Entry_conditioning: position-independent continuation relative to selling now; evaluated only after frozen Entry in replay
definition: 100*(mean(strictly later available executable sell opportunities)/EXIT_NOW executable sell price -1)
future_isolation: teacher values/raw future source suffix never passed to decision feature matrix
head: HOLD_CONTINUATION_VALUE
later_opportunities: regular raw opens strictly later than EXIT_NOW fill plus same-session terminal closing-auction close, one equally weighted observed opportunity each
missing_later_regular_minutes: not fabricated, not forward filled; label is observed available opportunity mean; scheduled coverage saved separately
